source_review_conclusions: Normal certificate/hostname TLS and exact endpoint200 before body; no shortlink/image/photo-page GET; no keys/login
Known single length or bounded unknown/chunked read, conflicting framing rejected, unknown at64KiB fails without extra read
Duplicate JSON keys and literal nonfinite constants remain rejected; new exponent overflow gate closes finite gap

Response static image URL must contain frozen numeric photoID; author URL is primary Flickr owner path; optional web_page must match same owner/photoID; derived canonical URL is labelled derived rather than observed
Author/title and explicit current license have separate16-slot denominators; missing/nonphoto/optout/conflict no backfill
Independent reader imports no producer engine, rehashes raw per-slot JSON and recalculates association/license; original terminal/Job records and worker/progress counts preserved
Actual publication MF/CLAIM/clean-source checks and exclusive local-only namespace remain, no rerun or change of endpoint/resource
limitations: oEmbed optional fields are not promised; even16 authors/title may leave0/16 current license proof
COCO license4 never supplies missing current license and any unknown extra declaration stays pending
Canonical photo link can be derived from actual oEmbed owner plus bound photoID, not a fetched photo-page assertion
Persisted response headers validated independently are still producer HTTP evidence, not a new independent network observation
passed flags distinguish terminal audit or author/title completion from license/full evaluation eligibility
Dataset_GO/training_GO/GPU_GO remain false; no native/scorer/near-duplicate/pixel qualification
